    "Comprehensive built-in features reduce reliance on external apps.",
    "Robust integration capabilities with ERP systems like Netsuite or Fishbowl.",
    "Effective tools for applying bulk discounts and promotions."

  "cons": [
    "Limited customization options for themes and store interfaces.",
    "Experiences occasional glitches that disrupt operations.",
    "Customer support quality can diminish when dealing with custom modifications."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Marketing Director, operating an e-commerce platform for a retail company, likely appreciates BigCommerce for its rich feature set and strong integration capabilities. While finding the platform generally easy to use, they may have faced frustrations with customization limitations and some stability issues. The value for money is considered fair, though customer support could be improved, particularly when custom solutions are involved."
